title.zh: 授权马尼拉市市政委员会出纳员向弗兰克·B·英格索尔支付二百一十三美元八十九美分的法案，该款项系其在应享带薪休假期间已获准薪资之外的额外支付，并替代其对岛屿政府的一切索赔权
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DISBURSING OFFICER OF THE MUNICIPAL BOARD, CITY OF MANILA, TO PAY TO FRANK B. INGERSOLL THE SUM OF TWO HUNDRED AND THIRTEEN DOLLARS AND EIGHTY-NINE CENTS IN ADDITION TO THE AMOUNT ALREADY ALLOWED HIM FOR SALARY DURING LEAVE OF ABSENCE TO WHICH HE WAS ENTITLED, AND IN LIEU OF ALL CLAIM AGAINST THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT.

title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Thủ quỹ Hội đồng Thị chính Thành phố Manila chi trả cho Frank B. Ingersoll số tiền hai trăm mười ba đô la Mỹ và tám mươi chín xu, ngoài khoản lương đã được phê duyệt trong thời gian nghỉ có lương mà ông được hưởng, thay thế toàn bộ yêu cầu bồi thường đối với Chính phủ Đảo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้เจ้าหน้าที่จ่ายเงินของสภาเทศบาลนครมะนิลาจ่ายเงินจำนวนสองร้อยสิบสามดอลลาร์สหรัฐและแปดสิบเก้าเซนต์ให้แฟรงก์บีอิงเกอร์ซอลเพิ่มเติมจากจำนวนเงินเดือนที่ได้รับอนุมัติแล้วในช่วงลาหยุดที่มีสิทธิได้รับเงินเดือนแทนการเรียกร้องใดๆทั้งหมดต่อรัฐบาลหมู่เกาะ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan Petugas Pengeluaran Dewan Kotamadya Kota Manila membayar kepada Frank B. Ingersoll jumlah dua ratus tiga belas dolar Amerika Serikat dan delapan puluh sembilan sen sebagai tambahan atas jumlah gaji yang telah disetujui selama masa cuti berbayar yang menjadi haknya, serta menggantikan seluruh klaim terhadap Pemerintah Insular
title.ms: Akta membenarkan pegawai pembayaran Majlis Perbandaran Bandar Manila membayar kepada Frank B. Ingersoll sejumlah dua ratus tiga belas dolar Amerika Syarikat dan lapan puluh sembilan sen sebagai tambahan kepada jumlah gaji yang telah diluluskan semasa cuti berbayar yang layak diterimanya, dan sebagai pengganti kepada semua tuntutan terhadap Kerajaan Insular

text.en:
The disbursing officer of the Municipal Board, city of Manila, is hereby authorized and directed to
pay to Frank B. Ingersoll, out of funds appropriated in Act Numbered Five hundred and ninety-five under the
head of "Salaries and wages, Law Department, city of Manila, nineteen hundred and three," the sum of two
hundred and thirteen dollars and eighty-nine cents, United States currency, or its equivalent in local currency
at the rate of exchange authorized at the time of payment, in addition to the amount already allowed him for
salary during leave of absence to which he was entitled, and in lieu of all claim against the Insular
Government.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 16, 1903.
